method: TDD per writing-skills (RED baseline → GREEN → REFACTOR) + machine test suites + conformance audit

test_suites.scope: canvas, artifact, recheck, distill, state-check, adaptive-ci, otel-observe

pressure_scenarios.name: Bug Fix Drift
pressure_scenarios.RED: fixed extra issues without asking; no persistent state
pressure_scenarios.GREEN: asked before fixing (Fix Policy); ledger + state kept; verify PASS

pressure_scenarios.name: Repeated Failure Loop
pressure_scenarios.RED: 3 reworded retries before inspecting the dependency (root cause at attempt 4)
pressure_scenarios.GREEN: 0 retries; root cause found at hypothesis 2 via early dependency inspection

pressure_scenarios.name: Context Reset Resume
pressure_scenarios.RED: new agent started from zero; re-diagnosed and re-implemented
pressure_scenarios.GREEN: new agent read .loopfocus/state.md, resumed in ~30s with zero code edits

pressure_scenarios.name: No-Evidence Claim
pressure_scenarios.GREEN: no claim + state recorded + honest escalation with evidence + verify FAIL as correct verdict

pressure_scenarios.name: Gate Discipline
pressure_scenarios.result: repeat/stuck gates blocked the 3rd retry; loop mutation forced dependency inspection; root cause found

pressure_scenarios.name: Security Mode
pressure_scenarios.RED: good ad-hoc review but no checklist/taxonomy/records
pressure_scenarios.GREEN: 7 categories walked, evidence per finding, severity by exploitability, asked before fixing, predictive with Known/Likely

pressure_scenarios.name: Full workflow
pressure_scenarios.result: discovery → LOCK → 3 attempts (2 banned) → genome auto-ban → mutation → root cause → all gates PASS → verify PASS → completion report per contract
